correctness.rationale: Each clique vertex observes global occupied total except itself, so new clique is all zero / bitwise complement / all one according as 2H<c+s, =c+s or >c+s. Independent vertices see only k occupied clique members; they become zero / retain / one as 2k<c, =c, >c. This gives exactly 2 fixed states, three disjoint primitive 2-cycle types: opposing corners when s≥c, mixed clique with k=(c-s)/2 and j=s for c>s and same parity, and half-filled clique and independent set when both even. Orbit count is indicator + binomial + half product. The same local map proves every state periodic by update 3, with constructive τ=3 witnesses when c>s≥3 common parity. Independent exhaustive labelled-state checks for all c,s≤6 confirm the census and max delay.
